b'# TinyDL

## Description
A minimalistic download CLI.

## Command Line Options
- **-u / --url**: Specify the URL to download.
- **-o / --output**: File to write the downloaded data. Defaults to stdout.
- **-q / --quiet**: Suppress progress output.

## Example Usage
```bash
tinydl -q https://example.com/file.bin -o output.bin
```
'
